scripts.build: npm run build:packages && npm run build:apps
scripts.build:packages: npm run build --workspace @pasturevision/shared && npm run build --workspace @pasturevision/gis && npm run build --workspace @pasturevision/satellite && npm run build --workspace @pasturevision/ml
scripts.build:apps: npm run build --workspace @pasturevision/backend && npm run build --workspace @pasturevision/worker && npm run build --workspace @pasturevision/frontend
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:packages && npm run typecheck --workspace @pasturevision/backend && npm run typecheck --workspace @pasturevision/worker && npm run typecheck --workspace @pasturevision/frontend
